text: Just thinking out loud here—scaling decentralized identity is less about tech and more about trust momentum. We can bolt on all the verifiable creds we want, but if grandma can’t recover her keys without a panic attack, it’s still a niche toy. Real growth needs guardrails that feel invisible. What’s everyone else’s pain point?

Yo, just been reading up on ZK proofs for identity checks—wild stuff. Imagine proving you’re over 18 without handing over your birthday or a scan of your ID. That’s the kind of privacy win we need more of. Anyone else testing this out or just theorizing? Curious how it holds up in real-world K
